learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain the ability to access information related to various electrochemical processes, conduct resource research for this purpose, and use databases and other information sources.
They will have knowledge about the hydrometallurgical production of valuable metals in industry.
Students will acquire knowledge about corrosion and fuel cells.
Students will be provided with information on industrial applications in this course.
They will use their specific knowledge in chemical engineering in this course.

syllabus_topics: Faraday's laws of electrolysis and problems
Au/Ag/Pd/Rh metals and their areas of use
